archiveTitle: Daily Brief | The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake set for November 5

entries.headline: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7: Black Ops 7 and Warzone bring back The Haunting in Season 06 on September 17
entries.summary: Activision says the September 17 update spans Black Ops 7 and Warzone, adding maps, limited-time modes, weapons and events. Hordepoint brings zombies into the fight over multiplayer objectives, while The Haunting also changes the Warzone experience.
entries.verification: Opened the Activision-authored PlayStation Blog announcement; claims stay within this edition’s evidence.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Asia/Shanghai; event and release dates are distinct.

entries.headline: In Control: Rocketry lets players build rockets and wire their own control panels
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Maximum Entertainment has announced Electromechanical Softworks’ space simulator for Steam in 2027. Players build rockets and assemble their own control panels with sensors, inputs, outputs and wiring, then test propulsion and control systems.
entries.verification: Based on the opened AUTOMATON report; this remains a media report, not independent primary confirmation.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Asia/Shanghai; event and release dates are distinct.

entries.headline: Attack on Titan 3 reveals a key visual for its MAPPA-produced opening animation
entries.summary: Gematsu reports that Koei Tecmo and Omega Force have revealed a key visual for the opening animation, produced by MAPPA. The report also lists a December 10 release for PS5, Xbox Series, Nintendo Switch 2 and Steam.
entries.verification: Based on the opened Gematsu report; this remains a media report, not independent primary confirmation.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Asia/Shanghai; event and release dates are distinct.

entries.headline: Nintendo Switch 2 — The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition: Nintendo plans Zelda 40th-anniversary Switch 2 hardware for October 29
entries.summary: Gematsu reports that Nintendo plans to release the anniversary Switch 2 on October 29 alongside a themed Pro Controller and carrying case with screen protector. A controller bundle with a display stand is reserved for selected Nintendo stores.
entries.verification: Based on the opened Gematsu report; this remains a media report, not independent primary confirmation.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Asia/Shanghai; event and release dates are distinct.

entries.headline: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds releases its Samba de Amigo content update
entries.summary: Gematsu reports that SEGA has released the Samba de Amigo content update and announced a subsequent in-game festival. This item concerns the update itself; the festival schedule is not a new release date for the game.
entries.verification: Based on the opened Gematsu report; this remains a media report, not independent primary confirmation.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Asia/Shanghai; event and release dates are distinct.

entries.headline: Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients announced as a Tang Dynasty RPG for 2027
entries.summary: Justdan International has announced an internally developed turn-based RPG set in the Tang Dynasty. Gematsu reports a 2027 release for PS5, Nintendo Switch 2, Switch and Steam, with combo-focused combat and both Simplified and Traditional Chinese among its language options. No exact release date was announced.
entries.verification: Based on the opened Gematsu report; this remains a media report, not independent primary confirmation.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Asia/Shanghai; event and release dates are distinct.

entries.headline: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake footage shows a jump button and revised aiming
entries.summary: VGC reports that Nintendo has shown the remake in action, including the opening forest and first dungeon. The footage shows a dedicated jump button and motion or stick aiming for the slingshot. This item covers the demonstration only; conflicting release-year reporting prevents us from treating the date as settled.
entries.verification: Based on VGC’s gameplay report. Conflicting release-year information is not treated as a confirmed date.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Asia/Shanghai; event and release dates are distinct.

entries.headline: Escape from Tarkov patch 1.1.5.0 maintenance targets a Lighthouse rework
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Battlestate Games began maintenance for patch 1.1.5.0 on September 8. The changes remove mines and stationary guns from the water treatment plant, relocate Rogues, and add underground routes, road cover and BTR patrols. The evidence describes maintenance and planned changes, not confirmed completion.
entries.verification: Based on the opened AUTOMATON report; this remains a media report, not independent primary confirmation.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Asia/Shanghai; event and release dates are distinct.

entries.headline: Path of Exile developer Chris Wilson reflects on decoy assets and data mining
entries.summary: AUTOMATON discusses Chris Wilson’s account of attempts to frustrate data mining by adding decoy assets to game data, and the problems those measures created. This is a retrospective on development methods and their costs, not a newly added gameplay mechanic.
entries.verification: Based on the opened AUTOMATON report; this remains a media report, not independent primary confirmation.
entries.timeNote: Source publication time converted to Asia/Shanghai; event and release dates are distinct.

entries.headline: CODE VEIN II releases Mask of Idris DLC and free Ver.2.0 update
entries.summary: Bandai Namco has released the Mask of Idris expansion DLC and free Ver.2.0 update for CODE VEIN II. The DLC adds new characters, two bosses, and new abilities, while Ver.2.0 includes previously announced additions.
entries.verification: The opening paragraph of the opened 4Gamer article explicitly records Bandai Namco’s release of the content. The page also incorporates older related reports, so this item uses only facts explicitly stated in the current opening paragraph.
entries.timeNote: The source lacks an exact publication time. The evidence packet places the event within the fixed window, so timing is confirmed only to the date.

entries.headline: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 set for November 5
entries.summary: Nintendo announced during its The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct that the Nintendo Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time will release on November 5. The two opened media sources agree on the month and day, but the packet contains conflicting years, so no year is stated here.
entries.verification: Famitsu and Denfaminicogamer both confirm a November 5 release. Their years conflict, so the year is deliberately omitted.
entries.timeNote: Denfaminicogamer’s explicitly timestamped publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Developer experiments with a fly neural model playing DOOM after researchers release its connectome
entries.summary: After HHMI Janelia Research and Google researchers released a connectome of a male fruit fly’s brain and central nervous system, engineer Alex Wormuth built the DOOMFLY experiment using MaleCNS v1.0. It maps game images to neural stimulation and neural activity to controls, and uses damage feedback in an attempt at reinforcement learning.
entries.verification: Based on the opened AUTOMATON article. Both the research release and DOOMFLY experiment remain attributed to the media report; the experimental attempt is not presented as a scientific conclusion.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON’s publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Complete Edition lowers PC and Xbox prices in some regions while raising Switch prices
entries.summary: CD PROJEKT RED has adjusted platform prices for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Complete Edition in some regions. AUTOMATON reports price cuts for PC and Xbox and an increase for Nintendo Switch; the official explanation links the changes to consolidation of older editions and the release of a remake.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON article quotes CD PROJEKT RED’s price-adjustment announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON’s publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.

entries.headline: Atelier Kalia set for February 25
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo announced that Atelier Kalia will launch on February 25 for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam. The game features open-area exploration and continues its recollection-themed setting.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Koei Tecmo’s date, platforms, and description of the game.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON’s publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition’s fixed window.
